title: Top-level agents module: types / registry / loader / runtime

findings.title: Explicit `allowed_tools: []` (and an omitted key) silently becomes wildcard `["*"]`
Builtin ids are not reserved: a user/project `main.md` makes `main` spawnable with wildcard tools, re-opening the escalation resolve_spawnable closes
register_from_dirs doc says boot passes project_dir = None; the only boot caller passes std::env::current_dir(), loading CWD project agents into the global registry
Advertised agent catalog is built without the project overlay the spawn path applies (two faces, two predicates); overlay shadowing is also never logged
Subagent transcript store has one writer and zero readers, plus a destructive GC and zeroed metrics on the error/timeout arm (R10: CUT)
with_allowed_tool_sets uses a value check as a provenance check, silently dropping an author's explicit ["*"]
spawnable_agent_ids re-derives the spawnability predicate and omits the mode filter for plugin agents
Agent ids validated only against the file stem; no charset/reserved-name check at the parse boundary
MAX_TRANSCRIPT_DIRS documented per-session but enforced across the whole transcripts root; GC derives its anchor via .parent()

clean_areas: run_context.rs task-local scoping, spawn-boundary capture via CarriedAttribution
Timeout classification prefix match cannot be spoofed (distinct prefixes for panic/failure)
RwLock poison recovery consistent across the registry
